work.title: Challenge B typed cash-event and malformed-adjustment evidence
authority: Direct user instruction to continue Project Redwood challenges and build work

intent.productGoal: Preserve the source semantics of healthcare cash events and surface malformed financial evidence without silent normalization.
intent.capability: Recognize Challenge B event_type as a canonical payment type, preserve source event labels in G4 cash-event evidence, retain patient-payment and recoupment behavior, and quarantine unsupported adjustment rows.
architecturalIntent: Challenge letters are aliases; proof identity follows verified source semantics.
Schema gaps and invalid rows remain visible in quarantine rather than being inferred into valid adjustments.
invariants: No adjustment ID or posting date is invented for malformed source rows.
Cash-event type classification is derived from the source event_type field.
Unreconciled A/R and blocked release gates remain visible.
acceptanceEvidence: Core mapping build/typecheck and focused semantic preflight.
Browser-created Challenge B run through the standard ZIP intake path.

decisions.decision: Add event_type as a payment_type alias and preserve its source value.
decisions.rationale: Challenge B supplies event semantics in event_type; recognizing that documented header preserves patient-payment and recoupment classifications without inventing data.

decisions.decision: Expose run-bound source labels and canonical treatment in G4.
decisions.rationale: The reviewer can verify partial-payment, patient-payment, and recoupment semantics without interpreting an aggregate cash total as a substitute for evidence.

decisions.decision: Do not normalize the adjustment rows.
decisions.rationale: They omit required adjustment IDs and posting dates, so accepting or synthesizing them would conceal a source-quality difference.

observedBehaviour: Browser-created run 51f02c71-1f02-41b6-a60f-a3137d3c8e55 was produced through the standard Challenge B ZIP intake path after the rebuilt server was restarted.
The persisted mapping for payments.event_type targets payment_type with confidence 1 under the authoritative configured alias rule.

G4 visibly presents the Cash-event evidence table. Its persisted in-scope rows are PAYER_PAYMENT / payer_payment: 287 events and $28,307.84; PATIENT_PAYMENT / patient_payment: 274 events and $5,759.30; PARTIAL_PAYMENT / payer_payment: 6 events and $490.07; RECOUPMENT / recoupment: 3 events and negative $94.74.
All-cash, ERA-to-bank, and matched-cash controls match at $34,462.47. The A/R-to-GL A/R difference remains $5,965.03 as one open finding with professional materiality unset.
All seven malformed adjustment rows remain quarantined for Missing adjustment ID. G1, G2, G3, G6, and G7 remain blocked; G4 passes, and Export visibly permits only a draft workbook.

evidence.result: SHA-256 debc8ab87800f8ca4d440f8f073c20c5df7df4afdd31a68d6704a2e9121b066d; complete source inventory matches persisted run 51f02c71-1f02-41b6-a60f-a3137d3c8e55.

evidence.result: Passed after the event_type, source-event preservation, G4 cash-event evidence, and readability changes.
Run records the source inventory, event-type mapping, canonical cash mix, quarantines, reconciliations, findings, and gate states.

evidence.reference: Browser screenshots supplied in the session for Reconcile, Analyze, and Export
evidence.result: Screenshots show matched cash controls, visible $5,965.03 A/R difference, populated cash-event evidence table, and draft-only release block.

divergences.expected: Challenge B denial/partial-allowance records enter the canonical adjustment population.
divergences.observed: All seven adjustment rows are quarantined because they omit required adjustment_id before a posting-date check can occur.
No verified payment event in the package is labeled as a reversal; three events classify as recoupment.

durableKnowledge: Challenge B is a cash-event source-semantic scenario, not a provider-departure scenario.
event_type is a documented external header spelling for payment_type.
Malformed adjustments must remain quarantined until a source-backed mapping contract exists.
G4 must display source event labels and canonical treatment together when source event semantics materially affect cash review.
